ART-OVERHAUL-002/E4.note: E4: the farmhouse's six bought furniture pieces (create_image_pro, style image = the int_* house art). The 24 and 32 px pro candidates came back shifted half a cell; reslice.py rejoins them. Picks: dresser24_fix/09, armchair24_fix/12, bookshelf2_fix/10, painting_fix/09, clock/15. The feather bed is a recolour of int_beds.png (no generation). 80 subscription generations (8 jobs, of which dresser, armchair and bookshelf at 32 px were rejected: three-quarter side panels, too wide), USD 0.

ART-OVERHAUL-002/E5.note: E5: winter bare trees by edit_image of the autumn sprites (Great Tree 192x192; farm maple 64x80 and big trek maple 52x71 in one call; orchard pears 48x64 x2; 13 trek maples and apples at 32x36). Trek maple frames 0-3 came back white-crowned and are not used (frames 4-7 serve all eight maples). Spring and summer are a scripted recolour (no generation). 40 subscription generations, USD 0.

FARMHOUSE-INTERIOR-001.note: The farmhouse interior's props and stone hearth: create_image_pro with style image raw/int_style.png (all four style aspects), prompts in the jobs' descriptions (straight-on front view for a top-down 3/4 RPG, dark outline, muted warm palette). 13 jobs, 130 subscription generations, USD 0 (balance 3324 generations before, credits USD 0). Several candidates came back split across a half cell; the picks are whole ones. The hearth's four stages are painted onto the one pick by fi001_props.py (soot, a split mantel and a crack at Decrepit), its chimney carried up 7 rows to the ceiling beam.

CCH-CONSOLIDATED-003/E.note: CCH-CONSOLIDATED-003 Phase E: the cave's bat, lizard and snake redrawn as real cave animals (no glowing eyes, muted hides) at their old size, each with idle, move, alert, attack, hurt and death.
